newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian government to back Tu-204 aircraft project.
newsitem.headline: Russian government to back Tu-204 aircraft project.

text.p: The Russian government will guarantee as-yet unreceived foreign credits for a project to build and lease 20 Tu-204 passenger aircraft, Itar-Tass news agency said on Monday.

The project was drawn up by Moscow Aviation International and Rosaviakonsortsium, grouping the Tupolev designers' group, the Aviadvigatel and Permskiye Motory engine-making plants and Aviastar. The planes would be equipped with Russian-made PS-90A engines.
Russian aircraft manufacturers are seeking to revive their flagging industry and to boost output to compete on the domestic market with foreign leased and purchased aircraft.
